🚀 cadcraft | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A fast, open-source alternative to AutoCAD for computer-aided design and drafting, accessible across multiple platforms and the web.
✨ Key Features: • AutoCAD-style interface and workflow • Command line interface • Object snaps • Layers • Dimensions
📖 Summary: CADCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of AutoCAD, built entirely in Rust. It aims to provide a fast and familiar CAD experience with features like command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, and hatches, running on multiple operating systems and the web.
